# Rings provenance

Chimes is a fixed-point reimplementation of the Rings DSP from
[pichenettes/eurorack](https://github.com/pichenettes/eurorack) at
`f4cfa7697095a28d292bff758beb51deb49b5a86` (stmlib at
`d18def816c51d1da0c108236928b2bbd25c17481`), MIT, copyright Emilie Gillet
([LICENSE](LICENSE)). Rings computes in floating point, which the OP-XY's
Blackfin does not have, so no upstream file is vendored verbatim: each Chimes
file follows the upstream code it names, formula for formula.

| Chimes | Upstream |
| --- | --- |
| [modal.h](../modal.h) | `rings/dsp/resonator.cc`, `Part::RenderModalVoice`, stmlib `Svf` and `CosineOscillator` |
| [string_models.h](../string_models.h) | `rings/dsp/string.cc`, `string.h` (`DampingFilter`), `plucker.h`, `Part::RenderStringVoice`, `Part::ComputeSympatheticStringsNotes` |
| [engine.cpp](../engine.cpp) | `Part::Process` at polyphony 4, `limiter.h` |
| [tables.h](../tables.h) | `rings/resources/lookup_tables.py`, regenerated by the repository's `tools/chimes_tables.py` |
| [fixed.h](../fixed.h) | stmlib `SoftLimit`, `DCBlocker`, `Random`, `SemitonesToRatio` and the `FREQUENCY_*` tangents |

The chord table is Rings' `BRYAN_CHORDS` set for polyphony 4.
